items.prompt: Masks x=10 (1010) and y=12 (1100) share which bit positions? Positions are numbered from zero at the right.

options.why: Those are the positions present in either mask, the bitwise OR result 1110.
1010 AND 1100 is 1000, so only position 3 is set in both masks.
Those are the positions present in exactly one mask, the XOR result 0110.
The leading 1 at position 3 occurs in both masks, so the intersection is nonempty.
